info.title: Leasefy Agent API
info.description:
Per-agency dashboard + onboarding API for the Leasefy cobranza autonomous agent service. AuthN = HS256 Bearer JWT with `agencyId` claim verified against `AGENT_JWT_SECRET`. AuthZ = `jwt.agencyId === :agencyId` path-param match (no cross-tenant reads).

---

## Async Event Channels

### cotizador/verdict.completed.v1

Emitted by the quote orchestrator (via redactAndEmit chokepoint) after every synchronous or streamed verdict. Consumed by cotizador-cost-aggregator and tenant-scoring-cotizador-recalibration Inngest functions.

**Payload (schema_version: '1.0'):**
- quote_id (UUID)
- tenant_id (UUID)
- cedula_hash (string — NEVER raw cédula, PII-redacted per G6/G7)
- verdict (approved | conditional | rejected | no_data)
- ranked_carriers (array)
- cohort_tags (array)
- degraded_carriers (array of {carrier, reason, since_iso})
- reasoning_trace_es (string — G6/G7 redacted)
- per_carrier_verdicts (object)
- schema_version ('1.0')
- timestamp (ISO-8601)

Breaking payload changes bump the topic to cotizador/verdict.completed.v2 per D-25-15.
This is an Inngest event, not an HTTP path — it does not appear in the paths object.

tags.name: cotizador
tags.description: Multi-aseguradora quote pipeline (Phase 24 D-24-19 contract): synchronous quote, SSE streaming, re-quote (interactive), cohort-taxonomy admin read. Server-to-server AGENT_API_KEY auth (no bearerAuth). Event channel: cotizador/verdict.completed.v1 (see info.description).

tags.name: cotizador.compliance
tags.description: Habeas Data / ARCO rights flow and PEP/OFAC compliance surfaces (Ley 1581/2012 + SARLAFT). Phase 26 D-26-18: five ARCO endpoints under the inmobiliaria-relay trust model. Auth: AGENT_API_KEY bearer (same as cotizador surface). Two-key counsel gate: COTIZADOR_ARCO_ENABLED env + compliance_acknowledgments ACK row.

bearerAuth.description: HS256-signed JWT carrying an `agencyId` claim. Verified against `AGENT_JWT_SECRET` shared between back-main + agent service.

workflowLatencyP50.description: P50 latency (ms) for non-agent workflow steps (Inngest tools, DB writes, etc.). Additive D-04 field — Phase 16-09. Optional for legacy clients.

workflowLatencyP95.description: P95 latency (ms) for non-agent workflow steps. Additive D-04 field — Phase 16-09. Optional for legacy clients.

get.description: Per-agency executive summary: total recovered, calls connected, open escalations, compliance flags. Real aggregations against billing_events + cobranza_calls + escalations + compliance_events (Phase 16 sub-plan 16-05).

schema.description: Bogotá-month bound (YYYY-MM)

get.description: Per-agency debtor portfolio: active count, promise-status breakdown, total outstanding debt. Phase 15 stub — Phase 16 wires real aggregations against debtors + payment_promises tables.
Per-agency call metrics: outcome breakdown, average duration, completion rate. Phase 15 stub — Phase 16 wires real aggregations against cobranza_calls.
Per-agency compliance metrics: event-type breakdown + recent audit_log rows. Phase 15 stub — Phase 16 wires real aggregations against compliance_events + audit_log.

Per-agency performance metrics: success-fee invoice estimate, agent latency P50/P95, aggregated token cost (USD). Phase 15 stub — Phase 16 wires real aggregations against billing_events + latency telemetry + llm_usage_events.

post.summary: Iniciar onboarding de inmobiliaria
post.description: PUBLIC entry-point to the self-service onboarding wizard. Creates a magic-link-anchored draft session and emails the resume link. The returned `sessionId` is opaque — clients MUST use the magic link from the email to drive subsequent step routes.

200.description: Session created + magic-link email queued (or stubbed)

get.description: PUBLIC re-entry point for the onboarding wizard. The magic-link from the /onboarding/start email is the auth surface — no JWT required. Returns the draft state + next-step pointer.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

404.description: Session not found for the (otherwise valid) token

410.description: Session past `expires_at` (7d hard limit per ADR-020)

post.summary: Onboarding step 1: agency (legal entity)
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Merges agency data into onboarding_sessions.draft.agency and advances current_step → members. Idempotent: re-POSTing with currentStep === agency overwrites the draft section without 409-ing.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

404.description: Session not found for the (otherwise valid) token

post.summary: Onboarding step 2: invited members (ADMIN/OPERATOR/VIEWER)
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Generates random invite tokens for each member; stores SHA-256 hashes in draft.members (D-12, T-15-03). Raw tokens are returned ONCE for the SPA to deliver via email. OWNER role is reserved for the onboarding initiator (D-02 singleton) and cannot be assigned here.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

200.description: Members persisted with hashed invite tokens

400.description: Malformed body (Zod) or OWNER role attempted

post.summary: Onboarding step 3: payment provider + sealed credentials
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Stores the provider name in draft.paymentProvider and a SEALED envelope of the credentials in draft.paymentCredentialsEncrypted (T-15-07 interim base64; KMS AES-256-GCM seal at /onboarding/complete). Raw credentials are NEVER logged or echoed back to the client.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

post.summary: Onboarding step 4: per-agency negotiation policy
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Drafts the per-agency policy (allowedPaymentPlans, max attempts, discount cap, plan-length cap, etc.) into draft.policy. All fields optional; defaults applied at /complete (sub-plan 15-09) per ADR-020.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

post.summary: Onboarding step 5a: mint presigned S3 PUT URL for HBD PDF
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Returns a 10-min presigned PUT URL locked to application/pdf + SSE-AES256 (T-15-04). The client uploads the bytes DIRECTLY to S3, then calls /confirm to persist the metadata. Does NOT mutate the draft.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

post.summary: Onboarding step 5b: confirm HBD PDF upload + persist metadata
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Called by the SPA after a successful presigned PUT to S3. Persists { s3Key, sha256, signedByFullName, signedByCedula, contractVersion } into draft.habeasData and advances current_step to habeas_data. Certicámara delivery is deferred to a Phase 14 background job (D-08).

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

post.summary: Onboarding step 6: atomic 4-table tenant commit
post.description: PUBLIC route — magic-link token IS the auth surface. Atomically creates the agency, agency_policies, N+1 agency_members (1 OWNER + N invited), habeas_data_delegations row inside a single prisma.$transaction. Emits cobranza/agency.onboarded for downstream hooks (Phase 16). Idempotent — re-POSTs after completion return the existing tenant.

schema.description: Magic-link JWT from the onboarding-start email

200.description: Tenant created (or returned existing on idempotent re-POST)

409.description: State-machine violation OR missing draft sections

get.description: Returns the full AgencyPolicy row for the agency (Phase 10/12/14/15 fields). KMS-sealed credential blobs are redacted to `<field>Configured: boolean`. Requires bearer JWT + membership row (any role).

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Policy row not found (tenant has not completed onboarding)

patch.description: Partial update of the AgencyPolicy row. Writes an audit_log row with `actorType="user"` + `payload={changedFields, before, after}` in the same transaction so the diff cannot diverge from the actual mutation. Requires bearer JWT + membership row with role ∈ {OWNER, ADMIN} (D-02 hierarchy).

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

get.summary: Get effective permissions for the calling member
get.description: Returns the effective permissions for the calling member broken down by module (cobranza + cotizador). Role → action mapping is defined in permissions-matrix.ts. No DB query in the handler — role is already verified by agencyRoleMiddleware.

200.description: Effective permissions per module for the calling member

get.description:
Returns the four KPI blocks + 7 stage rows + last 25 transitions + next 10 undispatched cadence contacts for the cobranza overview page (29-07). All debtor names are redacted to "FirstName I." (PII guard). Enforces cobranza:view permission from permissions-matrix.ts.

XR-01: Client (29-07) must also subscribe to Supabase Realtime channel 'agent:cartera_stage_transitions' filtered by tenant_id for live transition feed.

200.description: Cobranza overview aggregate — 4 KPIs + 7 stages + transitions + next actions

get.description:
Returns KPIs + last 10 quotes + carrier status for the cotizador overview page (30-04). All data is tenant-scoped via JWT-resolved agencyId. PII-safe: cedulaHash is truncated to first 8 chars only. Enforces cotizador:view permission from permissions-matrix.ts.

XR-01: Client (30-04) must also subscribe to Supabase Realtime channel 'agent:cotizador_quote_requests' filtered by tenant_id for live quote feed.

200.description: Cotizador overview aggregate — KPIs + last 10 quotes + carrier status

post.summary: Create a new insurance quote for a candidate

201.description: Quote request created; runExtendedQuote running in background

403.description: Forbidden — wrong tenant, insufficient role, or missing create-quote permission

451.description: ARCO blocklist — data subject has objected (D-26-09)

get.summary: Get quote metadata (inputs + status) for the operator UI.
get.description: Returns the persisted quote inputs (canon, ciudad, tipoInmueble) + cédula hash prefix + status timestamps. Used by the mvp streaming page to populate the header and the PDF inputs summary. No PII — cédula is only exposed as an 8-char prefix.

200.description: Quote metadata for the operator UI

404.description: Quote not found in this tenant

get.description: Returns a filterable, cursor-paginated list of debtors for the cobranza operator UI. Supports multi-select stage and channel filters, days-in-stage range, name LIKE, and cédula-hash-prefix lookup. PII (cédula, phone, email) is masked in responses; reveal is gated by 31-04. Requires cobranza:view from permissions-matrix.ts.

schema.description: Comma-separated CarteraStage values (S0,S1,…,SX). OR semantics.
Comma-separated channel values (voice,whatsapp,sms,email).
Free-text name LIKE %search%, or "HEX:<prefix>" for cedula_hash_prefix8.
Explicit cedula_hash_prefix8 lookup (8 hex chars). Overrides `search`.
Opaque base64url cursor from a prior response (nextCursor).

200.description: Debtors list page with optional nextCursor.

400.description: Malformed cursor (CursorDecodeError) or invalid query params.

get.summary: Stream Vapi call recording (Phase 31, range-byte proxy)
get.description: Agency-JWT-gated range-byte proxy that fetches a fresh Vapi signed URL per request and streams the underlying audio bytes to the client. The Vapi signed URL never reaches the client. Supports RFC 7233 Range requests (200 full body / 206 partial content). cache-control: no-store (T-31-PII).

200.description: Full audio body (no Range header sent).

404.description: Call not found, cross-tenant, or recording purged

get.description: Returns the header + sidebar payload for the debtor-detail page (COBR-UI-03). All PII fields (cédula, phone, email, fiador cédula) are masked by default — the reveal-PII flow ships in 31-04. Sub-tab endpoints (timeline/calls/memos/compromisos/audit) ship in 31-02b. Cross-tenant debtorId returns 404 (T-15-06 least-disclosure).

200.description: Debtor header + sidebar payload (PII masked by default)

404.description: Debtor not found (also returned for cross-tenant debtorId)

get.description: Merged chronological-DESC timeline of stage transitions, calls, approved payments, and memos for a debtor. Cursor-paginated by (occurred_at, source). Requires cobranza:view.

schema.description: Opaque base64url cursor from a prior response (nextCursor).

get.description: Cursor-paginated call list for a debtor. Per-call payload omits transcript (use /calls/{callId}/transcript). Requires cobranza:view.

200.description: Calls list page with optional nextCursor.

get.description: Cursor-paginated debtor memos (post-call summaries). Requires cobranza:view.
Returns paymentPlans + insuranceClaims + legalArtifacts for a debtor. No pagination; each sub-query capped at 100. Requires cobranza:view.
Cursor-paginated audit_log entries scoped to (entity_type=debtor, entity_id=:debtorId, tenant_id=:agencyId). Requires cobranza:view.

get.summary: Cobranza call detail (metadata + QA + state trace + cost).
get.description: Returns the read-only payload powering the Phase 31 call detail page (COBR-UI-04): call metadata, QA breakdown across 4 dimensions, compliance flags, the state-machine transitions overlapping the call window, and the cost panel. Audio bytes are NOT returned — they are streamed via the 31-05 audio proxy. recordingUrl is intentionally omitted (T-31-PII, D-31-10). Enforces cobranza:view from permissions-matrix.ts. Cross-tenant calls return 404 (T-15-06).

200.description: Call detail payload — metadata + QA + state trace + cost.

404.description: Call not found (or cross-tenant — T-15-06 enumeration guard).

get.summary: Cobranza call transcript — ordered turns for replay rendering.
get.description: Returns the ordered list of CallTurn rows for the Phase 31 call detail page (COBR-UI-04). Turns are ordered by startedAt ASC. Speaker tokens are normalized to the API union (operator | agent | customer). Live streaming is out of scope — replay only (D-31-19). Enforces cobranza:view from permissions-matrix.ts. Cross-tenant calls return 404 (T-15-06).

200.description: Ordered transcript turns array + total count.

404.description: Call not found (or cross-tenant — T-15-06 enumeration guard).

post.summary: Reveal a single PII field on a cobranza debtor (audit-logged)
post.description: Server-token-gated PII reveal endpoint (Phase 31, D-31-05/06/07/11). Writes an audit_log row with action="pii_reveal" BEFORE minting the 5-minute HS256 JWT. Requires cobranza:reveal-pii permission (OWNER / ADMIN / OPERATOR — VIEWER returns 403). Cross-tenant debtor lookups return 404 (no existence leak, T-15-06). If the underlying column is null (email / fiador_cedula), returns 404 to keep the reveal contract truthful.

400.description: Invalid field value (must be cedula | phone | email | fiador_cedula)

404.description: Debtor not found, cross-tenant, OR the underlying field value is null

500.description: Audit log write failed — token not minted (fail-safe)

post.summary: Pause cobranza for a debtor (D-31-01)
Force a debtor to a target cartera stage (D-31-02, admin-only)
Send an approved WhatsApp template to a debtor (D-31-03)

404.description: Debtor not found or has no phone

post.summary: Trigger a Vapi manual outbound call to a debtor (D-31-04, admin-only)

202.description: Stub-mode (VAPI_API_KEY unset) — audit written, no upstream call

404.description: Debtor not found or has no phone

503.description: Database unavailable or Vapi config missing

get.summary: List the approved WhatsApp templates available to this tenant

get.description: Paginated payments + atomic KPI strip. disbursement_pending_days is computed server-side (Mon-Fri only). PII masked. cobranza:view required.

schema.description: ISO date / datetime; defaults to 30 days ago.
ISO date / datetime; defaults to now.
Comma-separated provider values (wompi,bold).
Comma-separated status values (approved,pending,declined,disbursed).
Either "pending" or "settled".
Opaque base64url cursor from a prior response (nextCursor).

400.description: Malformed cursor or invalid query params.

post.summary: Create an A/B experiment for an agency (OWNER/ADMIN)
post.description: Creates an Experiment + its ExperimentVariant rows in a single transaction. Variant parameter_overrides must (a) only use the {max_discount_pct, max_term_months, prompt_variant_id} allowlist (D-08, .strict() Zod + DB CHECK), (b) NOT exceed the agency policy ceilings (D-07). Overlapping running experiments on the same targetMetric WARN (201 with warnings[]) — they do not block.

400.description: Malformed body, unknown override key, variant exceeds policy ceiling, or duplicate experimentKey

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Agency policy row missing (tenant not yet onboarded)

get.summary: Get an experiment + variants by key (any agency role)
get.description: Returns the experiment row plus its variants array. RLS narrows the lookup to the calling tenant, so a foreign experimentKey appears as 404 (never 200/403 leakage). VIEWER role is allowed — read access is open to all members of the agency.

404.description: Experiment not found for this tenant

patch.description: Validates the requested transition against the lifecycle state machine. Allowed: draft→running|paused, running→paused|completed, paused→running|draft|completed. completed is terminal (D-11). Pre-transition to `running` re-asserts SUM(variants.trafficPct)===100. `started_at` is set on first `running`; `ended_at` is set on `completed`. Body is .strict() — extra keys (e.g. traffic_pct) are rejected at the Zod boundary (Pitfall 5).

200.description: Status updated; returns the refreshed experiment

400.description: Unknown body key (Zod .strict) or traffic invariant broken at transition to running

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Experiment not found for this tenant

409.description: Transition not allowed by the lifecycle state machine

get.summary: Per-arm KPI + significance report for an experiment
get.description: Aggregates per-variant KPIs (assignments, kept/broken promises, completion rate, recovered COP, compliance flag rate) via the SQL function `agent.experiment_outcomes()` (SECURITY INVOKER → RLS inherits from withTenantScope). Computes pairwise significance vs control with Bonferroni-corrected alpha (α/(k-1)): ztest2prop for binary target metrics (kept_promise_rate, completion_rate), Welch two-sample t-test for continuous (recovered_cop_per_call). Emits a guardrail.breaches[] entry for any arm whose complianceFlagRate exceeds the control rate by more than 2 standard deviations of a proportion. Auto-stop is forbidden by D-08 — breaches surface in the response for the operator to act on. OPERATOR is allowed; VIEWER is not (D-02).

200.description: Report (or zero-shape skeleton when prisma is null in stub mode)

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Experiment not found for this tenant

post.summary: Compute + persist a payment-plan offer for a debtor (mid-call surface)
post.description: Reads the agency policy, computes the discounted offer per RESEARCH §4 tier defaults clamped by Math.min(tier, agencyMaxDiscountPct), generates a Wompi payment link, persists the plan + installments. Stages S4/S5/SX → 400 (no negotiation surface).

400.description: Malformed body OR stage in {S4, S5, SX} (no negotiation)

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Agency policy missing — tenant not yet onboarded

409.description: Duplicate offer for the same callId

get.summary: Fetch a payment plan + its installments
get.description: Returns the canonical plan shape. RLS narrows to the calling tenant — a plan belonging to another agency yields 404, never 403.

404.description: Plan not found in this tenant

post.summary: Mark a payment plan as accepted (offered → active)
post.description: Idempotent transition from `offered` to `active`. Repeated calls return the same accepted_at and 200. Status outside `offered`/`active` returns 409.

200.description: Plan accepted (or was already accepted — idempotent)

403.description: agencyId mismatch / no membership / insufficient role

404.description: Plan not found in this tenant

409.description: Plan is in a status that cannot accept (defaulted/cancelled/completed)

post.summary: Approve an AI-proposed payment plan (audit-first + Wompi mint)
post.description: Triple-gated approval: Zod body → Prisma policy/status/tenant guard → Wompi service runtime — all inside one prisma.$transaction. Audit row written BEFORE Wompi call (D-31-07 fail-safe). Cross-tenant planIds return 404 (no existence oracle, T-15-06). cobranza:approve required (OWNER + ADMIN only per 32-02).

404.description: Plan not found (or cross-tenant — no existence oracle)

409.description: Plan status is not "offered" OR stale optimistic-concurrency token

502.description: Wompi service runtime error — tx rolled back, plan not approved

post.summary: Reject an AI-proposed payment plan with canned reason + comment
post.description: Persists a canned reject_reason slug + optional free-text reject_comment. Audit-first ordering (D-31-07): audit row written before status flip. cobranza:approve required (OWNER + ADMIN only per 32-02).

409.description: Plan status is not "offered" OR stale optimistic-concurrency token

get.summary: List siniestro claims for a tenant (default: pending_human_review)

post.summary: Operator approve a siniestro filing — fan out PDF packet to selected insurers
post.description: Triple-gated approval (Zod + Prisma constraint + cobranza:approve). Writes audit_log + automated_decisions(reviewable=true) inside prisma.$transaction BEFORE per-insurer Resend dispatch. Partial Resend failure is tolerated (sent=false in insurerResults).

200.description: Approved — audit committed, Resend fan-out attempted

500.description: Audit / PDF assembly failed — transaction rolled back

get.summary: List legal artifacts for a tenant (filter by kind + status; default status=pending_human_review)

post.summary: Operator approve a pre-judicial letter — uploads PDF + 7-day signed URL
post.description: Triple-gated. audit_log + putAndSign live inside prisma.$transaction so S3 failure rolls back the audit row (T-32-04-06). NO email or WhatsApp dispatch — legal blocker. Returns presigned 7-day GET URL.

500.description: S3 / audit / PDF failed — rolled back

get.summary: Stream the legal artifact PDF (re-rendered from stored payload)

post.summary: Operator reject a siniestro filing — persists canned reason slug
Operator reject a pre-judicial letter — persists canned reason slug

get.description: Returns the daily operator report payload for the agency (RESEARCH §8 shape). Reads the cache when fresh (<1h); recomputes via SQL function + TS-derived alerts on miss (D-13 OVERRIDE — thresholds tunable via PATCH /api/agency/:agencyId/policy). Defaults `date` to today in America/Bogotá.
